description: To provide students hands-on experience of identifying, designing and implementing a substantial AI/ML project applying the concepts learnt across the programme, working individually or in small teams under faculty guidance.

syllabus.title: Project Work
syllabus.body: Problem identification and literature survey, requirement analysis and design, implementation, testing and evaluation, and documentation/presentation of a semester-long project executed under faculty supervision.

outcomes: Apply concepts and skills learnt across the curriculum to solve a real problem.
Demonstrate ability to plan, design, implement and evaluate a substantial project.
Communicate technical work effectively through a report and presentation.
